mode.description: Operating mode of the firewall engine; 'normal' or 'transparent'.

default_policy.description: Global default policies for each packet flow direction.

conn_table_size.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections tracked in the connection table.

conn_tracking_max.description: Upper limit for simultaneous connection tracking entries.

packet_buffer_size.description: Size (in bytes) of the per-CPU packet buffer ring.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logged events (e.g., debug, info, warning, error).

log_facility.description: Optional syslog facility for logs (e.g., 'local0'). If omitted, uses default.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces managed by the firewall.

zones.description: List of firewall zones for logical grouping of interfaces.

zone_assignments.description: Explicit interface-to-zone assignments (overrides implicit assignment from `interfaces`).
